criteria.name: Hook strength
criteria.notes: Opening two lines name the Alaska Plan, anchor to a hard December 31 expiration, and land a position-taking kicker within ~260 chars. Minus one because no dollar amount appears in the hook itself.

criteria.name: Industry relevance
criteria.notes: Four storylines woven together, each with a named sector, dollar amount, and capital or regulatory consequence. Editorial focus on telecom/federal-contracting leaves defense, aviation, and fisheries verified findings unused.

criteria.name: Factual density
criteria.notes: Nearly every sentence carries a specific noun (S. 98, USAC Alaska Plan, GCI Q1 figures, John Malone, $107M, $360M Quintillion ceiling, Koniag $147,542,030, HB 78 dates). Closing structural paragraph is argument rather than fact.

criteria.name: Source quality
criteria.notes: Most claims trace to high-confidence primary sources (White House OPS, GCI Liberty IR, BusinessWire, Alaska Public Media). Koniag figure rests on a single aggregator source with SAM.gov 404; post hedges with 'per SAM.gov as reported.' Dropped FCC ~Nov 8 deadline correctly omitted.

criteria.name: Voice match
criteria.notes: Reads closely to post_001.md. Reuses 'conventional read / true and incomplete' framing device. Structural binary framing, capital-consequence sentences, three-actor closing all match anchor. 'Navigate the architecture' is the one moment voice softens toward abstraction.

criteria.name: Readability (LinkedIn)
criteria.notes: Tight paragraphs, no walls, 463 words within operational 350-475 window. Minus two for no bullet block (rubric's 10 descriptor calls for one) and for sitting under the rubric's stated 500-700 word floor (even though operational target is 350-475).

criteria.name: Engagement question
criteria.notes: Specific, debatable, names three actor-classes (State, regional ANCs, anchor carrier), ties to central structural tension. Mirrors post_001's three-option closing format. Minus one because 'documentation cost' is technical framing for CFO skim-readers.

criteria.name: Business actionability
criteria.notes: Telecom CFO, ANC program director, or state broadband policy lead can identify multiple revisit-this-week triggers: Alaska Connect Fund readiness, FCC rulemaking timeline tracking, Koniag compliance benchmark, HB 78 workforce planning.
